title: Chapter 53 — The First Meeting: Trade Discovery
intro: Trade discovery, the capability story, terms, and the first-project close.

sections.title: Discovery for Trade
sections.content:
Trade discovery is different from retail discovery. You need to understand their business: how many projects per year, typical scope, preferred brands, current supplier relationship, pain points, and decision-making process.

The first meeting should end with either a first project to prove yourself — or a clear understanding of what they need before they are willing to try you. Either outcome is progress.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating first meetings, ask:

Does the salesperson complete trade discovery — or just pitch?
Do they understand the prospect's business model and pain points?
Are they closing for a trial project — or leaving without a next step?
